name: group_norm_silu
description: Fused GroupNorm followed by SiLU. x has shape [N,C,*spatial] (4-D in the tests), weight and bias have C elements, num_groups must divide C, and eps is the variance epsilon. Normalization uses the biased per-group variance over channels*spatial and float32 arithmetic; the result is y*sigmoid(y), cast back to x.dtype. Non-contiguous inputs are copied internally. Returns a new tensor with x's shape. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with C 64..512, spatial 8..64 and num_groups 8/32.
